verdict.rationale: Running checks is documented: `/loop` can rerun the test suite and report failures, background monitors can watch a CI run, hooks can run a formatter after edits, and AGENTS.md supplies build and test commands. Plan mode adds an approval gate before any edit, and session snapshots let you roll files back. There is no evidence of reviewing diffs, so only the checks half of the story is delivered. Missing for 10: a documented diff view or review of agent changes, any pre-merge or PR review workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the check features.
